## Access

Credentialed: approval plus training or identity checks. You need approval and proof of training or identity (for example a CITI certificate and a signed data use agreement).

## Before downloading

1. Create an account at https://bdsp.io, upload a CITI human-subjects research certificate and sign the BDSP data use agreement for this dataset.
2. Download following BDSP's instructions, then ingest with --from-dir.

## Credentials

None. The tool reads no credentials for it.

## Get the data

Download the files into a folder as the steps above say, then import the folder:

```bash
biosignal-data import bdsp/stanford-sleep-bench <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
